statement: For the deterministic charge-one grade-nine N=8 asymmetric codebooks, every rational scalar-output shift weight vanishing at -1, 0, 1 is zero. Two exact integer constraint blocks have full column rank modulo 65537, with the first block also reproducing the predecessor matrix hash. This is a finite fixed-codebook result and does not improve a SAT bound.
